messages:
Asha (CSM): Drafting a short customer-facing runbook for 'Priming & Steady-State' — focused on caching, batching, and streaming. Goal: give customers tactical steps to keep latency low during onboarding and reduce renewal risk by showing measurable improvements.
Ben (Eng): love it. can you list quick diagnostics we should surface in the UI so CS can show win metrics?
Asha (CSM): yes — CPU/GPU utilization spike, cold-start rate (requests that hit cold model), median token latency, streaming reconnects, cache hit rate. also % of requests served from kv-cache. keep metrics simple.
Carmen (PM): add a section for expected behavior during staged ramp (0-50 users, 50-500, 500+). helps set expectations for Qs that lead to renewal concerns.
Devon (SE): + sample troubleshooting commands we can hand to customers (for Private/Dedicated). e.g., `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/your-model/health`
Asha (CSM): yes — and a short checklist for the CS<>SE handoff: 1) confirm warm-pool config 2) enable prefix prefill for expected L0 prompts 3) set batching window to customer latency tolerance 4) configure streaming chunk size.
Ben (Eng): from runtime side: recommend quantization profile (int8) for cost constrained customers, but call out regen-quality checks in section. also suggest `batch_max_tokens=2048` for high-throughput non-low-latency workloads.
Asha (CSM): include example customer-facing messaging snippets:
- "We'll enable a short warm period before your big demo — this primes the model's cache so responses are consistent and fast."
- "If you see any lag > 500ms on median token, ping CS and we'll run a targeted warmup and review batching settings."
Carmen (PM): add renewal-risk rubric: green = cache_hit_rate > 70% & median_latency < 250ms; yellow = either metric degraded; red = persistent cold-starts or unaddressed errors for >72h.
Devon (SE): troubleshooting mini-run: 1) gather sample request IDs 2) check `kv_cache_hit_rate` and `inflight_batches` 3) run perf capture for 30s 4) if streaming dropouts, check client-side keepalive and grpc timeout. give sample query: `GET /v1/metrics?tenant=ACME&window=5m`
Asha (CSM): capture feedback loop: embed a short survey in the onboarding checklist (3 qns: latency ok?, outputs acceptable?, any trust/regulatory blockers?). store responses as tags for renewal team.
Ben (Eng): recommend automated warmup recipe for customers with scheduled demos: API to prefill a set of inputs for N workers for M minutes. include code snippet in runbook and a note about cost.
Asha (CSM): also include a compact 'what to tell customers' FAQ about batching:
- "Why do you batch?" => to reduce cost and increase throughput; may add small latency for interactive apps.
- "Can you turn batching off?" => yes for strict latency needs; we'll trade cost for latency.
Carmen (PM): propose a one-pager exportable PDF from Console with: checklist, diagnostic commands, expected metrics, renewal rubric, and a link to request SE assist.
Devon (SE): On Private installs, add KMS/HSM steps for telemetry masking + pointer to support flow.
OnboardBot: runbook-draft created by Asha. Share link: https://redwood.internal/runs/1790011111 (automated) :robot_face:
Asha (CSM): next steps: I'll stitch this into a short runbook and drop in the docs channel for review. aiming for a 1-page customer-facing PDF + internal triage checklist.
Ben (Eng): happy to review perf-run commands and a short example of perf capture output.
Carmen (PM): I'll add the renewal-risk thresholds and sample email template for renewal team.
Asha (CSM): thanks all — aim to publish by EOD Friday. low-friction, high-impact runbook, easy to hand to revival accounts. :thumbsup:
Devon (SE): If anyone wants, I can add a tiny bash script to call the health endpoints and produce a one-line summary for CS.
Asha (CSM): please do — that'll be super useful.
OnboardBot: reminder set for review meeting Fri 10:00am.
